note: Cases built from entities/entity_mutation.rs validate_trait_set_column_without_row (ORB_SET_COLUMN_WITHOUT_ROW), one resolved .orb orbital per case, each a positive or a paired control, and the expected findings the ones the core checks report (`program/validate`). The positives are a set with no persist, id or row payload anywhere (also across transitions and inside an `if`), a non-shared entity whose sibling persists, an entity with no persistence declared, a restate-persistor sibling that persists a different payload than the field is set from, an emit payload overridden by the event's own declared payload and a payload stamped with another entity. The controls are a persist create or update in the trait or a tick, a bound `(set @entity.id)`, a payload with an id or row field, a payload typed @entity, the entity or a list of it, a payload stamped with the entity, an @intrinsic field, a field that only scopes a fetch filter, a runtime entity, a [shared] entity persisted by a sibling, the restate-persistor idiom and a transition with no effects.
